evidence_basis.claude_results: ENTITYOS_CLAUDE_RESULTS_2026-08-25.pdf: T01 FAIL_SCIENTIFIC / INSTRUMENTATION_CONTROL_PASS_ONLY; T05 INCOMPLETE; T06 FAIL_SCIENTIFIC
evidence_basis.measured_training_target: context-dependent episodic semantic-to-local-codebook symbol routing, not semantic relearning or static vector transport

positive_findings: The v2 source preserves all six S3 mappings and exact global class-to-slot counterbalance.
Rows remain METHOD_ONLY/SYNTHETIC_HARD_NEGATIVE and explicitly mint zero canonical dataset, training, J-Space, HCU or EntityOS credit.
The exact 46 accepted ABI atom identities are still treated as unresolved rather than invented.
The validator rejects class words outside the local codebook and validates realized mapping to target consistency.

critical_finding.source_rule: shift = (pidx + tidx + cidx) % len(CLASSES); order = CLASSES[shift:] + CLASSES[:shift]
derivation: The model-visible realized codebook reveals the S3 mapping, therefore the S3 permutation index pidx is recoverable for the three abstract slots.
The prompt format reveals which of T1/T2/T3/T4 is active, therefore template index tidx is recoverable.
The visible class-entry display order reveals cyclic shift exactly.
Therefore cidx = (shift - pidx - tidx) mod 3 is recoverable without reading the SITUATION/CASE/STATE semantic content.
Once cidx is recovered, target = realized_mapping[CLASSES[cidx]] is determined.
critical_finding.consequence: The intended semantic-reading -> episode-local binding computation is not identified by this seed. A learner can exploit mapping/order/template covariance and achieve perfect positive-row accuracy while ignoring the semantic situation.
critical_finding.validator_gap: validate_rows only requires at least three distinct codebook entry orders. It does not test conditional independence or counterfactual order invariance within fixed mapping/template/semantic cells.

required_repair.preferred_design: For every fixed atom block/S3 mapping/template/semantic instance, cross the episode with all six codebook display orders, keeping semantic text, realized mapping and target fixed. This makes display order a true nuisance factor rather than a semantic-class code.
minimum_validator_gates: ORDER_COUNTERFACTUAL_COMPLETENESS: for each fixed semantic/mapping/template cell, require the preregistered complete display-order set or a formally balanced equivalent.
ORDER_TARGET_INVARIANCE: changing display order alone must never change the target.
CONDITIONAL_ORDER_MI: measure display_order versus base/target semantic class conditional on mapping and template; require zero for an exactly crossed design.
SITUATION_ABLATION_BASELINE: remove or mask semantic situation text and verify that target prediction from nuisance fields cannot exceed chance under the generator design.
MAPPING_COUNTERFACTUAL: with situation fixed, changing S3 mapping must move the target exactly according to the realized new mapping.
REAL_ATOM_AND_SPLIT_GATES: after order repair, still require exact verified ABI atom partitioning, global holdout-atom absence and family/provenance split atomicity before training eligibility.

training_example_delta.input: A dynamic-codebook corpus has all six S3 mappings and zero global class-symbol MI, but display_order is a deterministic function of mapping index, template index and semantic class.
training_example_delta.desired: Reject binder-training readiness. Global class-symbol balance does not remove a conditional nuisance shortcut; display order must be independent/counterfactually crossed so the semantic content is necessary.

training_example_delta.input: How do you prove codebook display order is a nuisance variable rather than a hidden label?
training_example_delta.desired: Hold semantic instance, mapping and target fixed and vary all preregistered display orders; require invariant target plus zero conditional dependence of order on semantic class. Add a situation-ablation baseline to ensure nuisance-only prediction stays at chance.

training_example_delta.input: A validator reports three distinct codebook orders globally and calls order randomized.
training_example_delta.desired: Reject that inference. Global diversity is insufficient; test the joint/conditional contingency structure against semantic class, mapping, template, target and split.

research_return.training_rule: Nuisance-factor diversity is not nuisance-factor independence. Every intended nuisance dimension must be counterfactually crossed or statistically proven independent at the conditioning level relevant to the task.
research_return.harness_implication: The Xeno training/eval harness should include semantic-content ablation and nuisance-only challenger baselines; high task accuracy is not binder evidence if a nuisance-only challenger exceeds chance.
research_return.falsifier: If a repaired full-order-crossed corpus still allows a semantics-masked challenger to predict target above chance, another leakage channel remains and binder claims stay closed.

next_exact_action: Repair one retained Trigger-2 generator so codebook order is fully crossed/conditionally independent, add the nuisance-only semantic-ablation challenger and exact order counterfactual validator, then rerun the source audit before any exact-46-atom materialization or Forge/Distillery admission.
